profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Result-oriented Senior Java Professional with proven success with development and implementation of IT solutions that contribute to product quality and value to potential and existing customers. Solid hands-on experience in software development, enhancement, and support. Key strengths include finding solutions under tight deadline, working independently without much supervising, and experience working with support personnel on customer issues.

Specialties: Server Side (J2EE):  JSP, SQL, JDBC, SERVLET, Web Service, RMI, JAXB, Apache Tomcat, Struts, NS-JMS, SeeBeyond Application Server, SeeBeyond Repository
Client Side (J2SE):  SWING, AWT, XML, XML Schema, HTML, NetBeans Module Development
•	Tools:  Eclipe IDE, Netbeans IDE, Apache Ant, JUnit, CVS, DBVisualizer, IBM Visual Age for Java
Operating System:  Linux, Unix, Solaris, HP-NonStop platform, AIX, Win2k, WinXP, Mac OSX
Enterprise Applications:  SeeBeyond eGate 4.5.x, ICAN 5.0.x, CAPS 5.1.x

positions.title: Sr. Platform Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented mobile attribution micoservice using Java Spring Boot.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and designed restaurant inventory management web app from scratch. (Play Framework 2.3.x, JPA, Postgres, Akka, WebSocket)

positions.title: Principal Engineer I
positions.description:
•	Implemented Groovy based E-Mail application running on Redhat Linux to ingest user email to update Remedy system using
−	Spring Framework, Log4J, Apache Common, Remedy Java API
•	Implemented new Remedy-based customizations to DIRECTV Broadcast Operations Support System to improve user experience. 
•	Performed requirement analysis and written design/requirement document for custom software projects.
•	Performed peer code reviews for team members and offer suggestions on improvements.
•	Support end users of Broadcast Operations Support System via email, phone, and in person. 
•	Design and implement Groovy script utilizing Remedy Java API to simplify & automate administrative workflow of the DIRECTV Broadcast Operations Support System.
•	Written SQL scripts to update and query Oracle 10g database.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained Enterprise-Level Front-End & Back-End applications as a Java Developer. Researched and implemented new technologies and solutions quickly to meet development deadline. Analyzed, troubleshoot and responded to customers’ urgent issues in timely manner. Assisted team members with development issues. Maintained, debugged and fixed bugs in the Sun SeeBeyond Integration product suite. Worked with associates to troubleshoot cross product solutions and issues.
